rows.note: This is the formal all-purpose term for the act or state of being confined.

example.english: Prolonged confinement can make people lose their freedom.
example.traditional: 長期禁錮會令人失去自由。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 gam3 gu3 wui6 ling6 jan4 sat1 heoi3 zi6 jau4

rows.note: Use this for a lockdown covering an entire city or territory.

example.english: The government imposed citywide confinement, so residents could not come and go freely.
example.traditional: 政府宣布封城，市民唔可以隨便出入。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 fung1 sing4 si5 man4 m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 ceot1 jap6

rows.note: Use this when the lockdown applies only to a particular district, building, or local area.

example.english: The building is under local confinement, so residents cannot leave tonight.
example.traditional: 呢棟大廈要封區，居民今晚唔可以落樓。
example.jyutping: ne1 dung3 daai6 haa6 jiu3 fung1 keoi1 geoi1 man4 gam1 maan1 m4 ho2 ji5 lok6 lau2
